name: software-developer
description: Implement requirements with TDD, diagnose and reproduce bugs, and review changes for project consistency, code quality, and security.

defaultPrompt: Use $software-developer:implement-feature to implement a use case or requirement with test-driven development.
Use $software-developer:diagnose-bug to investigate a reported bug and reproduce it with a regression test.
Use $software-developer:review-code-changes to review my changes against the project's standards and architecture decisions.
